headline: Local Plumber Finds Nothing But A Single Miniature Plastic Boat Inside Delhi Jal Board Mainline
body:
Local plumbing contractor Ramesh Kumar, who was summoned to investigate persistent low pressure in a South Delhi neighborhood, claims he retrieved a singular, hand-painted miniature wooden boat from the heart of the Delhi Jal Board’s primary distribution valve this morning.

“I expected to find layers of calcification or perhaps a stray discarded pipe fitting, but instead, I pulled out a perfectly preserved, two-inch-long schooner with a tiny flag labeled ‘Sailing to Serenity’,” said Kumar, while still holding the damp artifact with a pair of rusty pliers. “The residents were baffled, but once the boat was removed, the water pressure immediately returned to a level that would make a fire hose blush.”

Experts from the local maintenance department are currently treating the incident as a logistical anomaly rather than a systemic failure. Chief engineer Devinder Singh noted that the agency has no official policy regarding maritime vessels entering the municipal water supply. “We are looking into how such a sophisticated aquatic toy bypassed our complex filtration network, but for now, we are simply happy the water is flowing again,” Singh added, confirming the boat has been moved to the department’s ‘Evidence of Mystery’ cupboard.

Meanwhile, local residents have started lining up at the site of the repair, with many hoping to catch a glimpse of the miniature vessel. “I’ve lived here for forty years and never suspected our water was powered by a tiny ship’s crew,” said neighborhood resident Sunita Rao, who brought a thermos of tea to watch the ongoing investigation. “It’s comforting to know that even when the taps go dry, someone somewhere is still technically navigating the pipes.”
caption: Mystery solved: A tiny boat was blocking the city's water supply all along. We really do live in the strangest timeline. 🚢💧 #DelhiJalBoard #MysteryPlumbing #DelhiLife #UrbanLegends (satire)
